title: Lightning Q2_0 mixed card/CPU down-projection combine contract
notes: Synthetic Q2_0 weights at hidden 2688, expert width 1856 and shared width 3712; four routed experts, with experts 0 and 2 on the host and 1 and 3 on the card. The reference is one lt_mv_q2_down launch over all four slots plus the shared expert; the mixed path uses one lt_mv_q2_down_parts call over all four slots (the host slots are compared with Q2Matrix.partials and then replaced by them), lt_q2_shared_parts for the shared expert and one lt_q2_combine. Both zero-residual and non-zero-residual outputs are bit-identical, the shared-only branch is bit-identical, and the host partials match lt_mv_q2_down_parts for slots 0 and 2. Each routed slot has its own stack of lt_quant runs, as the engine does. This is not Engine wiring and not a model row: no kindi_lightning pack exists on this host, so no verify or tok/s is claimed.
